end.summary:
Practised estimating a large collection using groups of 10 as a guide.
Answered 2 of 6 attempts without help.
Identified that 40 is close to 43.
Initially counted groups as single objects; later used 3 groups of 10 to say 30 peanuts.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making estimates by grouping objects into tens and comparing with a nearby number. Ananya used the idea of 3 groups of 10 to estimate 30 peanuts, and later recognised that 40 is close to 43. They first treated 5 groups of 10 as 5 objects, but this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, make small groups of 10 items and ask, “How many groups? About how many items altogether?”
